description:
This 2020 Toyota Tundra TRD Pro in black represents a serious work truck built for demanding conditions and owners who expect performance and reliability.

- 4WD with TRD Pro Suspension for enhanced off-road capability
- Hard Tri-Fold Tonneau Cover for secure bed protection
- Spray-On Bedliner to protect against wear and damage
- Predator Steps for convenient truck bed access
- i-Force 5.7L V8 engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- Premium JBL Audio system with SiriusXM and navigation
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Power Tilt & Slide Moonroof with sliding sunshade
- Leather front bucket seats with TRD Pro logos
- 18 BBS forged aluminum wheels in satin black
- TRD Pro Dual Exhaust system
- Rigid Industries LED Fog Lights
- Backup camera with glass breakage sensor
- Auto high-beam headlights and front fog lights
- Active cruise control and electronic stability control

With only 2,278 miles on the odometer, this single-owner vehicle maintains the balance of its factory warranty and has passed Toyota's comprehensive Gold Certified inspection. The TRD Pro package delivers genuine truck capability with specialized suspension tuning, professional-grade styling, and premium appointments that distinguish it from standard models. The 38-gallon fuel tank provides extended range for both work and recreational use. Inside, the cabin combines comfort with technology, featuring heated power adjustable seats, a navigation system, and climate controls for year-round driving comfort.

Toyota's certification program ensures your complete peace of mind with the following protections and services:

- Multipoint Inspection
- Roadside Assistance
- Warranty Deductible: $0
- Transferable Warranty
- Vehicle History
- Limited Warranty: 12 Month/12,000 Mile Limited Comprehensive Warranty: 12 Month/12,000 Mile (whichever comes first) from certified purchase date
- Powertrain Limited Warranty: 84 Month/100,000 Mile (whichever comes first) from TCUV purchase date
- Roadside Assistance for 7 Year / 100,000 Mile
- Standard New-Car Financing Rates Available
- Warranty honored at over 1,400 Toyota dealers in the continental U.S. & Canada
- Trade-ins accepted
- Trouble-free handling of your transaction, including DMV paperwork

The truck delivers solid fuel economy ratings of 13 mpg city and 17 mpg highway, reasonable for a full-size V8 pickup. Its 4WD capability and TRD Pro-tuned suspension make it equally at home tackling rugged terrain or handling everyday driving. The spray-on bedliner and tonneau cover protect your investment and cargo, while the Predator Steps provide practical bed access without climbing.

This Tundra TRD Pro combines professional truck capability with genuine luxury touches. Whether you need a vehicle for work, weekend adventures, or daily driving, this truck delivers the dependability Toyota is known for with the premium features you want. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this truck's commanding presence and refined capability firsthand.

This 2022 Ford F-350SD Limited represents a serious work truck built for demanding jobs and the drivers who take them seriously.

- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and specially tuned shock absorbers
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Turbodiesel with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Limited Slip differential with 4.10 axle ratio for enhanced traction
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition and connected navigation
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with memory positioning
- Power moonroof with overhead console and ambient lighting
- Dual rear wheels for increased load capacity and stability

- Remote keyless entry and garage door transmitter

The Limited trim elevates this F-350SD with upscale appointments that don't compromise the truck's working capability. Hill Descent Control and off-road-tuned shocks work together to maintain control on steep terrain. The limited slip differential with 4.10 axle ratio delivers the traction you need whether navigating rough terrain or managing heavy loads.

The Power Stroke 6.7L turbodiesel paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission provides the capability to handle substantial work demands. Dual rear wheels increase load stability and weight distribution, making this truck suitable for serious hauling. The 397 amp alternator ensures sufficient electrical capacity for power-hungry job site equipment and accessories.

Silver paint over the muscular F-350SD profile turns heads wherever you go. This truck wears its work ethic openly while maintaining the refined appearance expected from a Limited model. The 17-inch forged polished aluminum wheels contribute to its commanding presence on any surface.

This 2022 F-350SD Limited sits ready to prove its capability on your property, your job site, or the open road. With 72,666 miles on the odometer, it remains well-maintained and prepared for years of reliable service. Step into the cab and experience a truck that balances luxury amenities with uncompromising utility-a vehicle engineered for those who demand the best from both worlds.

The surround vision system with trailer view provisions, rear cross traffic alert, and hitch guidance simplify maneuvering. OnStar connectivity and GMC Connected Services keep you informed and in control.

The all-weather floor liners, spray-on bed liner with Denali logo, and polished exhaust tip reflect attention to detail inside and out. The Corvette's handling prowess comes from its four-wheel independent suspension, electronic stability control, and speed-sensing steering. This 2027 Ford Expedition Active delivers substantial capability and refinement for families and professionals who demand both space and performance. With its EcoBoost 3.5L V6 twin-turbocharged engine paired to a 10-Speed Automatic transmission, this three-row SUV provides the power and efficiency needed for highway driving and weekend adventures alike.

- Equipment Group 202A Touring Package with 9.75 Axle and 7-passenger seating
- 2nd Row Power-Folding Captain's Chairs with tip-and-slide and armrests
- Ford Split Gate with power upper liftgate and power lower tailgate
- BlueCruise Equipped with 1 Year and 90-Day Plan for hands-free highway driving
- Ford Connectivity Package with 5G, unlimited Wi-Fi hotspot, and 7-year coverage
- Pro Power Onboard 400W in console and cargo area
- Heated Steering Wheel and Memory Driver Seat
- Dual Power-Folding Sideview Mirrors with autofold and ground illuminators
- Auto High-beam Headlights with rain-sensitive windshield wipers
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 with Intersection Assist and Lane Change Assist
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Navigation system featuring Google Maps
- Exterior Parking Camera with 4-Wheel Disc Brakes and ABS
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and 6-speaker SiriusXM 360L audio system
- Transparent Pricing

The spacious interior accommodates up to seven passengers with thoughtful design throughout. The 3rd row vinyl seats feature auto-retracting head restraints, while the power-folding captain's chairs in the second row maximize flexibility for cargo or passengers. All three rows benefit from dedicated climate control, including front dual-zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning, ensuring comfort for every occupant regardless of seating position.

Technology integration enhances every drive with connectivity and convenience features. The Ford Digital Experience powered by 5G connectivity enables unlimited Wi-Fi hotspot capability for entertainment and productivity, while the included navigation system with Google Maps and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keeps your attention on the road. BlueCruise hands-free driving technology operates on 97% of controlled access highways across the U.S. and Canada, with lane-change assist for added confidence.

Safety receives comprehensive attention through multiple systems. Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 includes intersection assist to help you navigate complex traffic scenarios, while electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain control and handling. Dual front impact airbags, side-impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide layered protection for all occupants. The 911 Assist emergency communication system and security system further strengthen peace of mind.

The Active's EcoBoost engine achieves an estimated 16 MPG city and 24 MPG highway, delivering respectable efficiency for a three-row SUV of this size and capacity. The 10-speed automatic transmission optimizes power delivery and fuel economy across varied driving conditions. Ride quality benefits from the four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering, which adjusts responsiveness based on vehicle speed.

Visit our showroom to experience this 2027 Ford Expedition Active firsthand. We invite you to explore its spacious interior, test the intuitive technology features, and discover how this vehicle fits your active lifestyle with Transparent Pricing that reflects genuine value.

- 14 Speaker Meridian Audio System with SiriusXM
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay & Android Auto

Entertainment options include a 14-speaker audio system, SiriusXM satellite radio, and full smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. This 2024 Toyota Tundra Hybrid Limited represents a thoughtful choice for buyers seeking capability without compromise on efficiency. Built as a one-owner vehicle with a clean Carfax history, this truck combines serious truck functionality with the fuel economy benefits of hybrid technology.

- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay integration
- Premium JBL audio system with 12 speakers and subwoofer
- Power panoramic sunroof with tilt, slide, and power sunshade
- Navigation system with 14-inch touchscreen
- Leather heated and ventilated front bucket seats
- Nightshade Package with 20-inch matte-black alloy wheels
- Black overfenders and rear bumper styling
- 400W/120V AC power supply for rear seat and bed
- Qi-compatible wireless smartphone charger
- Dash cam with recording capability
- Heated leather steering wheel
- Non-skid spray-on bed liner
- All-weather floor liners
- Stainless steel door edge guards
- Toyota Safety Connect with 10-year trial

The Tundra Hybrid pairs a 3.4L V6 engine with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, delivering 19 city and 22 highway MPG. This powertrain offers the torque and towing capacity truck owners expect while reducing fuel consumption compared to conventional gasoline engines. The hybrid system works seamlessly in the background, optimizing power delivery whether you're navigating city streets or highway driving.

Inside, the cabin reflects the Limited trim's commitment to comfort and technology. Leather seating with heating and ventilation keeps occupants comfortable across seasons, while the power panoramic sunroof opens up the cabin space. The heated steering wheel enhances cold-weather driving, and the wireless smartphone charger keeps your devices powered without cable clutter.

The Nightshade Package elevates this truck's visual presence with distinctive styling cues. The gloss-black window molding, door handles, and mirror caps create a cohesive modern look, while the 20-inch matte-black alloy wheels and black overfenders add purposeful attitude. The rear bumper styling complements the overall design without compromising functionality.

Practical features enhance daily ownership. The non-skid bed liner protects your cargo area, while the all-weather floor liners keep the interior clean regardless of conditions. The integrated dash cam provides security and documentation when you need it. For those who stay connected, the wireless charger and AC power supply ensure your devices and equipment remain ready to use.

This truck represents value backed by Toyota's reputation for durability and reliability. With the Lifetime Powertrain Warranty available, you can own this Tundra Hybrid with confidence. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand schedule a test drive and discover why the combination of hybrid efficiency, truck capability, and modern comfort makes this Limited model a compelling choice.

This 2027 Chrysler Pacifica Limited is an elegant family vehicle finished in Blue that brings together comfort, capability, and confidence for every journey you take with those who matter most.

- 360 Surround View Camera System with ParkSense technology
- Safety Sphere advanced safety suite
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 10.1" touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with 13 speakers
- Nappa leather bucket seats with heating and ventilation
- Power moonroof
- Heated steering wheel
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning
- 18" diamond cut painted alloy wheels
- Power liftgate and power doors
- 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot
- MyFlexCare service plan included
- Three-row seating with split folding rear seat and reclining third row

The Pacifica Limited provides a commanding driving position with its AWD suspension system, delivering the stability and control you need across varying road conditions. The 3.6L V6 engine with nine-speed automatic transmission generates responsive power while the modern suspension architecture ensures a smooth and composed ride. City driving delivers 17 MPG efficiency, while highway cruising achieves 25 MPG, balancing performance with practical fuel economy.

Interior comfort receives significant attention with dual-zone automatic climate control, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seats for passenger satisfaction. The Uconnect 5 system with its 10.1-inch display integrates seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected without distraction. The 13-speaker audio system with integrated active noise cancellation transforms your cabin into a sanctuary of sound quality.

Safety features demonstrate Chrysler's commitment to protecting your family. The 360 Surround View Camera system provides complete visibility around the vehicle, while ParkSense front and rear park assist with stop technology simplifies parking maneuvers. Additional safety measures include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, ABS brakes, and a comprehensive airbag system with occupant sensing technology.

Practical considerations matter in family vehicles. The power liftgate grants easy trunk access even with hands full, while the split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row seat accommodate flexible cargo and passenger arrangements. The power driver seat with memory function allows you to find your ideal driving position instantly, and the telescoping steering wheel adjusts to your preference.

Buying a car should be a fun, worry free experience. You can trust that our friendly, non-commissioned sales consultants have your best interests in mind, as they are not paid based on which vehicle you buy or how much money you spend, but rather your satisfaction. Get ready to experience serious power and premium comfort with this stunning 2020 Ram 2500 Laramie 4D Crew Cab. Coated in a glossy Diamond Black Crystal Pearlcoat, this heavy-duty truck looks sharp and means business. Under the hood sits the legendary Cummins 6.7L I6 Turbodiesel engine paired with a rugged 4WD system, giving you all the muscle you need for tough jobs or weekend getaways. Best of all, it features a Clean CARFAX and is a CARFAX One-Owner vehicle, letting you drive away with complete confidence.

This truck looks just as good as it performs thanks to the Sport Appearance Package, which brings a body-color grille surround, body-color door handles, painted front and rear bumpers, and sleek black interior accents. Ready to take things off the beaten path? The Off Road Package equips this Ram with front and rear performance-tuned shock absorbers, tow hooks, hill descent control, and off-road decals, ensuring you can handle rough terrain with absolute style.

Hooking up a trailer and hitting the highway has never been easier. Packed with the Towing Technology Group, this truck offers a Surround View Camera System, Trailer Reverse Guidance, and a center stop lamp with a cargo view camera so you can see every single angle. It also features power chrome tow mirrors with a convex spotter and memory settings, making your towing experience simple, safe, and stress-free.

Inside the cabin, you are treated to a first-class experience courtesy of the Laramie Level 1 Equipment Group. Stay perfectly cozy in any season with heated and ventilated front seats and a heated leather steering wheel. Finding your ideal driving setup is a breeze with 8-way power-adjustable front seats and power-adjustable pedals with memory. Plus, convenient extras like dual-zone automatic temperature control, second-row in-floor storage bins, and door trim bottle inserts keep everyone happy on long road trips.

Staying connected and safe on the go is entirely effortless. The modern dash comes loaded with GPS Navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto for seamless smartphone integration, alongside multiple SiriusXM services and trials. For your peace of mind, advanced safety features like Blind Spot & Cross Path Detection, auto high-beam headlamp control, and rain-sensitive windshield wipers work around the clock to keep you protected on every journey.

This 2020 Ford F-250SD King Ranch in blue represents the pinnacle of heavy-duty truck capability, combining luxury appointments with genuine work-ready performance. Whether you're managing a demanding job site or towing significant loads, this truck delivers the features and engineering you need to handle it all with confidence.

- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and specialized shock absorbers
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- King Ranch Ultimate Package including power-deployable running boards and twin panel moonroof
- High Capacity Trailer Tow Package with 30,000 lbs GCW and Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System
- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package with integrated connections
- Quad Beam LED headlamps and LED taillamps with fog lights
- Heated rear seats and multi-contour front seats with leather
- Adaptive Cruise Control with collision warning and Pro Trailer Backup Assist
- 20 bright machined cast aluminum wheels with King Ranch badging
- SYNC 3 communications system with SiriusXM and B&O premium audio
- Navigation system with rear and 360-degree camera suite
- Electronic-locking differential with 3.55 axle ratio
- Engine block heater for reliable cold-weather starts

The King Ranch trim elevates the F-250SD with refined comfort and distinctive styling. The leather-appointed 40/console/40 front seats provide exceptional comfort during long drives, while heated rear seats and a heated steering wheel ensure comfort regardless of season. The twin panel power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, creating an open, premium environment. Power-deployable running boards make entry and exit effortless, even when wearing work gear.

This truck's towing and hauling capabilities are engineered to meet professional demands. The High Capacity Trailer Tow Package increases the gross combined weight rating to 30,000 pounds, while the 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package includes attachment points and connections for serious hauling. The Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System provides 360-degree visibility, rear view camera, and trailer reverse guidance essential tools for precision backing and safe operation in tight spaces.

The FX4 Off-Road Package demonstrates Ford's commitment to capable engineering. Hill Descent Control helps you navigate steep terrain safely, while off-road specifically tuned shock absorbers and skid plates for the transfer case and fuel tank protect critical components. The electronic-locking differential with 3.55 axle ratio provides enhanced traction when terrain demands it.

Technology and safety work seamlessly together in this F-250SD. Adaptive Cruise Control with collision warning keeps you alert during highway miles, while Pro Trailer Backup Assist takes the guesswork out of maneuvering trailers into tight spaces. The SYNC 3 system integrates seamlessly with your smartphone, offering hands-free calling, texting, and audio streaming. The B&O premium audio system with 10 speakers delivers impressive sound quality for your commute or workday.

This King Ranch F-250SD is ready to serve as your reliable partner for years to come. With its combination of luxury, capability, and technology, it's built for those who demand the very best from their truck. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the truck's commanding presence and refined comfort firsthand.

This 2024 Toyota Tundra SR5 in White delivers the capability and comfort you need from a full-size truck. With a 3.4L V6 engine paired with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck is built to handle real work while maintaining fuel efficiency with an estimated 17 city and 23 highway MPG. As a one-owner local trade, this Tundra comes with the assurance of a well-maintained vehicle ready for its next owner.

- 4WD capability for all-weather driving

- SR5 Premium Package featuring dual zone automatic climate control

- Leather steering wheel
- 18 alloy wheels
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 9 speakers
- Exterior rear parking camera
- Remote keyless entry and automatic headlights
- Front fog lights and heated power door mirrors

- Safety Connect emergency communication system (10-year trial)
- Full suite of airbags including dual front impact, side impact, and overhead airbags

The SR5 Premium Package elevates your driving experience with heated front seats that adjust eight ways, providing comfort on long drives and cold mornings. The dual zone automatic climate control lets you and your passenger set preferred temperatures independently. Convenience features include telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjustment, trip computer, and an overhead console for accessible storage. The power adjustable lumbar support ensures proper back support during extended driving sessions.

Safety is paramount in this truck, with electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, and a comprehensive airbag system. The rear window defroster, speed-sensing steering, and auto high-beam headlights add practical everyday benefits. With fully automatic headlights and delay-off functionality, you'll have optimized visibility in any condition. The brake assist system works seamlessly with the four-wheel disc brakes to provide confident stopping power.

The interior combines durability with comfort through SofTex seat trim on the front bucket seats with a center armrest. The split folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo or passengers. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road while managing your entertainment system. The rear step bumper and body-color bumpers maintain the truck's finished appearance while offering practical functionality.

This Tundra SR5 represents a solid investment in a capable, well-equipped truck that balances work performance with modern conveniences. The combination of 4WD capability, comprehensive safety features, and the SR5 Premium Package makes this an excellent choice for those seeking reliability and comfort. We invite you to visit our showroom to see this truck in person and discuss how it meets your needs.

The Highlander XLE seats up to eight passengers across three rows, making it ideal for larger families or those who frequently travel with groups. Front bucket seats provide individual comfort for the driver and front passenger, while heated front seats add warmth during cooler months.

Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures passenger comfort across different seating areas, while rear air conditioning maintains comfort for rear passengers. A power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading.

Safety has been designed into every aspect of this Highlander. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and traction control work together to help protect occupants. A rear-view camera assists when backing, and low tire pressure warning helps you maintain proper maintenance.

Additional conveniences include steering wheel-mounted audio controls, a garage door transmitter, heated door mirrors with power adjustment, and a power moonroof to brighten the cabin. Automatic headlights and delay-off functionality ensure visibility and convenience in various lighting conditions.

With its Clean Carfax history and low mileage, this Highlander XLE represents a well-maintained midsize crossover ready for the next chapter of ownership. Come see this vehicle in person and discover the comfort and functionality that has made the Highlander one of the most trusted family vehicles on the road.

* Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
* Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
* Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
* Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

This 2003 Mercedes-Benz SL-Class SL 500 represents a significant investment in luxury and performance. With just over 56,000 miles, this convertible has been carefully maintained and remains an excellent example of Mercedes-Benz engineering. The silver exterior presents a classic, timeless appearance that complements the vehicle's sophisticated character.

The heart of this SL 500 is its 5.0L V8 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, delivering the power and refinement expected from this iconic model. The rear-wheel-drive configuration provides the dynamic handling characteristics that define the SL-Class driving experience. You'll appreciate the responsive performance balanced with the practical efficiency of highway driving at 22 MPG.

When the roof is raised, the integrated wind blocker enhances the cabin environment for comfortable highway cruising.

The memory seat functionality stores your preferred driving position, while the power-adjustable front seats ensure personalized comfort for both driver and passenger. Dual-zone automatic temperature control, along with a rear window defroster, maintains your comfort in all weather conditions.

The 17-inch silver alloy wheels complement the exterior styling while providing a solid foundation for the vehicle's performance. Four-wheel independent suspension with adaptive and auto-leveling capabilities ensures a smooth, controlled ride. The speed-sensing steering adjusts to vehicle speed for enhanced control and responsiveness.

This SL 500 combines luxury, capability, and distinctive design in a convertible package that continues to turn heads. This 2008 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sahara delivers the versatility and capability you expect from this iconic nameplate, ready to handle whatever your lifestyle demands.

- Easy Folding Soft Top
- Freedom Top 3-Piece Modular Hard Top
- 3.8L V6 Engine with 4-Speed Automatic Transmission

The dual top system gives you the freedom to choose your driving experience, with both an easy-folding soft top and the Freedom Top 3-piece hard top included. This flexibility means you can enjoy open-air driving when weather permits or secure hardtop protection when you need it. The combination appeals to owners who want options without compromise.

Under the hood, the 3.8L V6 engine paired with a 4-speed automatic transmission provides the power and dependability Wrangler owners appreciate. The anti-spin rear differential enhances traction control when navigating challenging terrain, while the heavy-duty suspension with gas shocks supports both on-road comfort and off-road capability. Four-wheel drive ensures you maintain control in various driving conditions.

Entertainment and connectivity are handled by an AM/FM stereo with a 6-disc CD/DVD changer, MP3 playback capability, and SIRIUS Satellite Radio to keep you connected on every journey. The auxiliary input jack provides additional flexibility for your audio preferences. Front fog lights improve visibility in challenging weather, while the electronic stability and traction control systems work to maintain vehicle stability.

The interior reflects thoughtful design with premium cloth low-back bucket seats, a split folding rear seat for flexible cargo management, and front center armrest for added comfort. Climate control includes air conditioning and rear window defrost functionality. Power windows, tilt steering wheel, and remote keyless entry add everyday convenience, while the trip computer and outside temperature display keep useful information at your fingertips.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, occupant sensing technology, brake assist, anti-lock brakes, and integrated roll-over protection designed for the open-frame nature of Wrangler vehicles. The 4-wheel disc brake system provides responsive stopping power, and low tire pressure warning helps maintain proper tire condition.

The trailer tow group equipped with a class II receiver hitch and 4-pin trailer connector wiring, combined with the 3.73 axle ratio, prepares this Wrangler for towing duties. This practical addition makes the vehicle suitable for owners who need to haul equipment or recreational gear.

Come see this 2008 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sahara and discover how its combination of capability, versatility, and practical features aligns with your driving needs.

description:
The 2002 GMC Sierra 2500HD SLE Extended Cab is a heavy-duty pickup from an era when full-size trucks were built with straightforward controls and durable hardware. Its SLE trim level places it above the most basic versions of the model line, while the Extended Cab body provides additional interior space behind the front seating area. The truck was designed for work use as well as everyday driving, with the higher-duty chassis and component selection that distinguished the 2500HD series from lighter-duty pickups. Its proportions reflect the needs of a large-capacity truck, with a body and frame intended to handle demanding loads and regular towing duty without relying on more elaborate electronic systems. The exterior presentation is functional, with broad fenders, a tall stance, and simple trim details that match the truck's intended role.

Inside, the cab follows the practical approach common to GMC trucks of this period. The SLE designation adds a level of comfort and convenience equipment beyond the most basic specification, while the extended cab body provides extra enclosed space for passengers or cargo. The cabin layout keeps the controls within easy reach and uses a familiar arrangement that was common across GM trucks at the time. Seating is positioned for a commanding view of the road, and the additional rear access points make the extended cab more useful than a standard two-door regular cab. The materials and switchgear are consistent with a truck that was meant to see regular use, and the interior design favors durability over ornamentation. The included keyless entry adds a convenient feature that allows access without using the key at the door each time.

Power and capability are central to this truck's identity. The 2500HD designation indicates a heavier-duty rating than a half-ton pickup, with suspension and underpinnings selected for higher work demands. GMC offered this model with powertrain choices suited to towing, hauling, and general utility use, and the truck's engineering reflects that emphasis. The chassis and running gear were built to support substantial loads, and the vehicle's size and hardware give it the presence expected from a heavy-duty pickup of this era. Braking, steering, and ride characteristics are tuned for the weight and purpose of the truck rather than for a light-duty feel. The truck's equipment and structure are aimed at steady operation under the kinds of conditions that matter in jobsite, farm, or trailer use.

The Sierra 2500HD also carries the familiar design language GMC used in the early 2000s, with a square-edged body and a front end that emphasizes function over decoration. The SLE trim adds a cleaner appearance than the base work-truck versions, but the overall look remains practical and conservative. Large mirrors, a tall cab, and a bed built for utility all fit with the truck's role. The extended cab gives the side profile more length than a standard cab model, and the proportions are balanced around usable passenger and cargo space rather than compact size. Features are limited to those that were selected for this vehicle, with keyless entry as the listed option, and the rest of the truck's appeal comes from its heavy-duty construction, straightforward interior, and the basic capabilities expected from a 2002 GMC Sierra 2500HD SLE Extended Cab.

This 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse delivers the performance and distinctive style that defines modern muscle car excellence.

- 5.0L V8 DOHC 32V engine with Tremec 6-Speed Manual transmission
- Notorious Blue Unique Brake Calipers and Unique Hood Graphic
- Painted Black Roof for striking visual contrast
- Memory Driver Seat & Mirrors with 3 settings for personalized comfort
- Climate-Controlled Bucket Seats with heating capability
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 12 speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- SYNC 4.0 QNX with Connected Navigation and touchscreen interface

- Active Anti-Theft System with Approach Detection and Wheel Locking Kit

The 5.0L V8 engine paired with the Tremec 6-Speed Manual transmission provides direct, engaging control that enthusiasts demand. The adaptive suspension system with four-wheel independent configuration and speed-sensing steering ensures responsive handling whether you're navigating daily commutes or exploring open highways. The B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen delivers premium audio quality with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio, and SYNC 4.0 QNX with Connected Navigation keeps you informed and entertained. The electronic-locking center console and active anti-theft system provide enhanced security for your peace of mind.

Technology and safety work seamlessly together in this Dark Horse. Automatic headlights with delay-off functionality, rain-sensing wipers, and rear parking sensors with exterior parking camera support confident driving in any condition. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and electronic stability control provide comprehensive protection. The 911 Assist emergency communication system adds another layer of security.

With low mileage and meticulous attention to detail, this 2024 Mustang Dark Horse represents an exceptional opportunity to own a modern performance icon that combines raw power with refined everyday capability.

This 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 in green represents a full-size SUV built for those who demand capability, comfort, and refined performance in a vehicle that commands the road.

- Front 6-Piston Brembo Brake Upgrade with red calipers and 16.1 rotors
- Dual-Pane Power Panoramic Sunroof with express-open and power sunshade
- Power-Sliding Floor Console with secure storage and manual sliding armrest
- Z71 Off-Road Package with off-road capability and performance enhancements
- Air Ride Adaptive Suspension with Magnetic Ride Control
- 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case with Electronic Limited-Slip Differential
- Hill Descent Control for enhanced off-road control
- Bose 9-Speaker Premium Audio System with SiriusXM 360L and Navigation
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Wireless Charging and Universal Home Remote
- Heated and Cooled Front Seats with power adjustment and memory settings
- Power Release Second Row Bucket Seats with power-folding third row
- HD Surround Vision with integrated trailer brake controller
- Illuminated Chevrolet emblems and sill plates throughout
- Black Roof Rack Cross Rails and black tubular assist steps

The EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission delivers the power expected from the Z71 platform, while the 4WD system ensures confidence on any terrain. Fuel economy registers at 14 city and 18 highway MPG. The vehicle has been driven just under 29,000 miles since its 2024 model year introduction, representing careful ownership.

The Z71 Off-Road Package bundles the Luxury Package, Max Trailering Package, and Off-Road Capability Package into one comprehensive offering. This means you receive integrated trailer brake control, smart trailer integration, hitch view with pan and zoom adjustment, and recovery hooks ready for serious towing and hauling demands. The Advanced Trailering Package further enhances capability with professional-grade functionality.

Comfort extends throughout the cabin with heated steering wheel, heated and cooled front outboard seats, and an auto-dimming interior rear-view mirror that reduces glare during night driving. The power-sliding center console provides innovative storage solutions, while the dual-zone automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature. Navigation comes standard, guiding you whether you're on city streets or backcountry roads.

Safety is addressed through a comprehensive suite of features including nine airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and advanced driver assistance technology such as lane change alert with side blind zone alert and rear cross traffic alert. The Brembo brake upgrade, featuring color-matched red calipers front and rear, provides premium stopping power.

The Tahoe Z71 combines refined luxury with genuine off-road capability. This vehicle awaits your visit to the showroom so you can experience the quality engineering and thoughtful design that define this platform.

Inside the bed, a 120-volt power outlet enables you to charge tools or equipment on site. Remote vehicle start means you can warm up or cool down the cabin before stepping outside.

Safety technologies work actively to help protect you and your passengers. Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, and Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning monitor the road and intervene when necessary. A high-definition rear vision camera displays on the touchscreen for backing maneuvers, while intelBeam automatic high beams adjust illumination based on oncoming traffic.

This 2023 Silverado 1500 RST offers the perfect balance of work-ready capability, off-road confidence, and daily-driving refinement. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand how this truck can serve your lifestyle.

The 2025 Honda HR-V EX-L represents a practical and well-equipped compact crossover designed for drivers who value both versatility and comfort. This black AWD model combines efficient performance with modern conveniences to enhance your daily driving experience.

- 2.0L I4 DOHC 16V i-VTEC engine with CVT transmission and AWD capability
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow functionality
- Blind Spot Information System warning
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- 180-Watt audio system with 8 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Heated front bucket seats with leather trim
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and exterior parking camera
- Power moonroof for added light and airiness
- 17-inch machine-finished alloy wheels
- Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone A/C
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off feature
- Multiple airbags including dual front and side impact, knee, and overhead protection

The HR-V delivers 25 city MPG and 30 highway MPG, offering balanced efficiency for both urban commuting and longer drives. The compact crossover's design provides practical interior space while maintaining responsive handling characteristics. The AWD system enhances traction and stability across various road conditions and weather, giving you confidence in your vehicle's capability.

Inside, the EX-L trim focuses on driver comfort and accessibility. Heated leather-trimmed front bucket seats accommodate extended drives during colder months, while the power-adjustable driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position. The automatic climate control system maintains separate temperature zones for driver and passenger, ensuring everyone stays comfortable. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob contribute to the premium feel of the cabin, while dual-zone air conditioning provides individualized comfort management.

Technology integration simplifies connectivity. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allow seamless smartphone integration for navigation, music, and communication. The SiriusXM satellite radio system offers extensive entertainment options, supported by the eight-speaker audio system. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep common functions within reach, minimizing driver distraction.

Safety features throughout the vehicle provide comprehensive protection. The Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles outside your direct line of sight, while the rear-view camera assists with backing maneuvers. Adaptive Cruise Control maintains a set distance from traffic ahead, reducing fatigue during highway driving. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain vehicle control in challenging conditions, supported by four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering.

The EX-L trim offers thoughtful details designed to simplify ownership. The power moonroof brings natural light and ventilation to the cabin, while the automatic headlights adjust to ambient lighting conditions. Heated door mirrors and windshield wipers ensure clear visibility during winter weather. Illuminated entry points and front and rear reading lights enhance usability throughout the cabin.

This 2025 Honda HR-V EX-L combines everyday practicality with refined amenities, making it an excellent choice for drivers seeking a dependable compact crossover with meaningful features and capable performance. We welcome the opportunity to help you explore this vehicle further and answer any questions about its capabilities.
